response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count * 1.0 / AVG(order_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM c
